task_methods.plan: Break down the research questions and define task dependencies, roles, and acceptance criteria.
task_methods.replan: Revise the plan from observed gaps and failures, replacing work that cannot execute.
task_methods.discover: Search candidate sources, select independent evidence, and preserve reviewable snapshots.
task_methods.deep_read: Read sources closely and extract located quotations, data, and interpretations.
task_methods.verify: Cross-check claims with independent sources and test consistency and scope.
task_methods.counter_search: Actively search for counterevidence, conflicting data, and failure conditions.
task_methods.synthesize: Build the report from verified claims and evidence, answering each research question.
task_methods.quality_gate: Have an independent Agent assess coverage, depth, source quality, and readability.
task_methods.citation_audit: Check each report claim against its quotation, locator, and source snapshot.

create_params.title: Research parameters
create_params.hint: Tune depth, source weights, and report language. Defaults are fine to start; values are submitted with create and visible in the session.
create_params.depth_hint: Depth sets the product-round budget: deeper means more rounds and coverage, at higher cost.

standard.label: Standard
standard.hint: Default — about 5 rounds for most questions.

create_params.weights_hint: 0–1 scale; higher means prefer that source class. Defaults favor official and authoritative secondary sources.

community.label: Community / sentiment
community.hint: Forums, social, and reviews — use as supplement.

create_params.language_hint: Preferred language for delivery and the written report.
